purpose: Teach: ひっくり返し/潰す/すこぶる/おち/のぼっ/戴き/なけりゃ/ばらつき

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがカードをひっくり返して見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Grandpa showed you his card trick, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, conversational observation. Soft rhythm, like she's piecing together the day from his expression. Gentle lift at the end, inviting him to elaborate. Close, present attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの自信を潰す事言っちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I said something that made Dad lose his confidence.
lines.style: Quiet admission, head slightly down. Fast word-run through the middle, then catches himself. Guilt underneath but trying to be honest about it. Small, uncertain voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃん、すこぶる元気でいらしたわね
lines.en: Sho — Grandpa was in such wonderful spirits, wasn't he?
lines.style: Pleased confirmation, almost marveling. Slight emphasis on 'wonderful.' Slower pace, letting the pleasure settle. Warm smile in the voice. The relief of noticing something good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、笑い話のおちが上手だって褒められたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said I told the punchline really well.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. Quick, eager delivery on the praise. Small-voiced still — not bragging, just reporting something that made him glow inside. Pride without arrogance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが山にのぼっていらしたわよ
lines.en: Sho — your father went mountain climbing, you know.
lines.style: Information offered gently, with a touch of pensiveness. Mid-pace, like she's thinking of him as she speaks. Slight trailing-off, protective of whatever feeling sits underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんからおみやげを戴きました
lines.en: Mom, Grandma gave me a souvenir.
lines.style: Excited but controlled — not a shout, but the words come faster. Light emphasis on 'gave me.' Eager to share, waiting to see her reaction. The pleasure of being remembered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがいなけりゃ、お家は寂しいわね
lines.en: Sho — if Grandpa weren't here, home would feel so lonely.
lines.style: Tender, almost musing. Slow, careful words. Not sorrowful — reflective, the quiet recognition of who holds the warmth. Soft voice, like she's speaking a truth she doesn't need to loudly proclaim.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きの色にばらつきがあるって言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, someone said my colors in my drawing weren't quite even.
lines.style: Slight uncertainty in the delivery. Processing feedback without quite defending it. Quieter than before, more inward-turned. Not hurt, but thinking it over. The seriousness of a 6-year-old artist considering criticism.
